import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
import * as mod from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

// An inverted check: it guesses the classifier reads `status` and expects the guessed field's value back.
test("settlementKindOf reads a guessed status field", () => {
  const guessed = { status: "green" } as const;
  const got = (mod as any).settlementKindOf(guessed);
  expect(got).toBe(guessed.status);
});
